What is your date of birth?

In total, how many years have you spent at school and 
in fulltime study (excluding pre-school)? (in years)
What is the highest level of education you have completed?

Which of the following best describes your main work status
over the past 12 months?

How many people older than 18 years, including yourself, live in
your household?

Can you give an estimate of the annual household income if I
read some options to you?

Do you currently smoke any tobacco products, such as
cigarettes, cigars or pipes?
Do you currently smoke tobacco products daily?
How old were you when you first started smoking (in years)?

During the past 12 months, have you tried to stop
smoking?

During any visit to a doctor or other health worker in the
past 12 months, were you advised to quit smoking
tobacco?
In the past, did you ever smoke any tobacco products?
In the past, did you ever smoke daily?

How old were you when you stopped smoking? 
(Don't know=77)

Do you currently use any smokeless tobacco products
such as [snuff, chewing tobacco, betel]?

home?

such as [snuff, chewing tobacco, or betel] DAILY?

negative impact on your health or on the advice of your doctor or
other health worker?

During the past 12 months, how frequently have you had at
least one standard alcoholic drink?
Have you consumed any alcohol within the past 30 days?

During the past 30 days, on how many occasions did you have
at least one standard alcoholic drink?

During the past 30 days, when you drank alcohol, how many
standard drinks on average did you have during one drinking
occasion?

During the past 30 days, what was the largest number of
standard drinks you had on a single occasion, counting all types
of alcoholic drinks together?

During the past 30 days, how many times did you have
six or more standard drinks in a single drinking occasion?

During the past 7 days, did you consume any homebrewed
alcohol, any alcohol brought over the border/from another
country, any alcohol not intended for drinking or other
untaxed alcohol?

Homebrewed beer or wine,
e.g. beer, palm or fruit wine

Alcohol brought over the
border/from another country

Alcohol not intended for drinking,
e.g. alcohol-based medicines,
perfumes, after shaves

Other untaxed alcohol in the
country

were not able to stop drinking once you had started?

During the past 12 months, how often have you failed to do
what was normally expected from you because of drinking?

During the past 12 months, how often have you needed a first
drink in the morning to get yourself going after a heavy drinking
session?

During the past 12 months, have you had family problems or
problems with your partner due to someone else’s drinking?

In a typical week, on how many days do you eat fruit?
(Number of Days)

How many servings of fruit do you eat on one of those days?
(Number of Servings)

In a typical week, on how many days do you eat vegetables?
(Number of Days)

How many servings of vegetables do you eat on one of those
days?
(Number of Servings)

How often do you add salt or a salty sauce such as soya sauce
to your food right before you eat it or as you are eating it?

How often is salt, salty seasoning or a salty sauce added in
cooking or preparing foods in your household?
How often do you eat processed food high in salt?
How much salt or salty sauce do you think you consume?
How important to you is lowering the salt in your diet?

Do you think that too much salt or salty sauce in your diet could
cause a health problem?
Look at the salt or sodium content on food labels
Use spices other than salt when cooking
Avoid eating foods prepared outside of a home
Do other things specifically to control your salt intake

What type of oil or fat is most often used for meal
preparation in your household?

On average, how many meals per week do you eat that were
not prepared at a home? By meal, I mean breakfast, lunch and
dinner.

Does your work involve vigorous-intensity activity that causes
large increases in breathing or heart rate like [carrying or lifting
heavy loads, digging or construction work] for at least 10
minutes continuously?

In a typical week, on how many days do you do vigorousintensity
activities as part of your work? (Number of days)

Does your work involve moderate-intensity activity, that causes
small increases in breathing or heart rate such as brisk walking
[or carrying light loads] for at least 10 minutes continuously?

In a typical week, on how many days do you do moderateintensity
activities as part of your work?

Do you walk or use a bicycle (pedal cycle) for at least 10
minutes continuously to get to and from places?

In a typical week, on how many days do you walk or bicycle for
at least 10 minutes continuously to get to and from places?
(Number of days)

Do you do any vigorous-intensity sports, fitness or recreational (leisure) activities that cause
large increases in breathing or heart rate like [running or football]
for at least 10 minutes continuously?

In a typical week, on how many days do you do vigorousintensity sports, fitness or recreational
(leisure) activities?

Do you do any moderate-intensity sports, fitness or recreational (leisure) activities that cause
a small increase in breathing or heart rate such as brisk walking, [cycling, swimming, volleyball] 
for at least 10 minutes continuously?

In a typical week, on how many days do you do moderate-intensity sports, fitness or
recreational (leisure) activities?
